about.label: About
about.title: Get to know me better
about.para1: I am an AI Engineer with a solid foundation in Data Science, specializing in designing and deploying end-to-end intelligent systems from scratch. My technical expertise spans across managing the full data lifecycle, building scalable data pipelines, developing advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures, and integrating autonomous AI agents that bridge raw data with production environments. Having hands-on engineering experience in transforming complex data challenges into robust solutions, I focus on building reliable systems that perform seamlessly under real-world constraints.
about.para2: Building advanced AI is only half the battle because the real challenge lies in bridging the gap between cutting-edge technology and everyday operational bottlenecks. Across modern businesses, countless hours are still wasted on manual data handling, sluggish document searches, and repetitive decision-making processes that stunt growth. This is where an AI engineer turns complexity into a competitive advantage by automating tedious operations, unlocking hidden insights from unstructured data, and turning sluggish workflows into high-speed engines for scalable success.

hierarchicalRag.name: Hierarchical RAG Chatbot
hierarchicalRag.shortDescription: Hierarchical RAG chatbot combining RAPTOR-style tree construction with IRCoT-guided reasoning for deep multi-hop question answering.
hierarchicalRag.challenge: Answering questions that require reasoning beyond simple semantic similarity, especially on long, complex documents.
hierarchicalRag.approach: Built an embedding and clustering pipeline (multilingual-e5-large-instruct, UMAP, BIC-optimized Gaussian Mixture Models) to structure documents into a hierarchical tree, then used an adaptive DFS traversal with dual-threshold pruning and interleaved reasoning generation to guide retrieval.
hierarchicalRag.result: Evaluated across four benchmark datasets with statistical significance testing, showing consistent gains on NarrativeQA and QASPER. Deployed with a FastAPI backend, Qdrant as the vector store, and vLLM serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ.

plDataWarehouse.name: Premier League Data Warehouse
plDataWarehouse.shortDescription: Automated data pipeline extracting Premier League player, team, and fixture stats into a modeled data warehouse.
plDataWarehouse.challenge: Keeping football statistics up to date and analysis-ready without manual data pulls.
plDataWarehouse.approach: Built a scheduled pipeline with GitHub Actions to extract data from the Fantasy Premier League API, loaded it into BigQuery, and modeled it with dbt.
plDataWarehouse.result: A production-style pipeline that runs on a recurring schedule with zero manual intervention.

internalRagChatbot.name: Internal RAG Chatbot
internalRagChatbot.shortDescription: Internal RAG chatbot built during a Data Scientist internship to answer employee questions about company policy and structure.
internalRagChatbot.challenge: Routing employee questions to the right document category and falling back gracefully for out-of-scope queries.
internalRagChatbot.approach: Combined Gemini 1.5 Flash-Lite and Qdrant for retrieval with a Random Forest classifier for query routing.
internalRagChatbot.result: Reduced reliance on manual lookups by giving employees instant, accurate answers to common questions.
